# CANDIDATE: NARROW_ORB_VOLUME_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A narrow opening range (OR) with below-average volume indicates suppressed volatility; a break of the OR on elevated volume captures the ensuing volatility expansion. This setup aims to enter early in the breakout move with volume confirmation, avoiding the whipsaw risk of retest-dependent ORB strategies.

## Mechanism
Define OR (first 30 min) high/low. If OR width < 0.25% of price AND average volume in first 30 min < 0.8 × 20‑day average volume of same period, wait for a breakout: price closes beyond OR high (long) or below OR low (short) with volume on that bar > 1.5 × 20‑day average volume of that time‑of‑day. Enter at close of breakout bar in direction of breakout. Exit: chart-stop at opposite OR edge, TP1 at 1.0R (risk = entry to OR opposite edge), runner using chandelier trail (ATR×3) from entry. Regime hint: Works when VIX between 12‑22 and time 09:45‑10:30 EST; avoid first 15 min after open and high‑VIX (>25) or low‑volume holidays.
